description: Partial Proposed0030 finite-session expiry contract: exact closure observations, durable offline occurrences, BOOTTIME-domain anchors, conditional timer/Open ordering and bounded checkpoint/timer work. This describes implementation/system reception, not fixture-oracle qualification or general MQTT conformance.

rules.guard: An attached transport never expires from its retention interval. Expiry starts only from one captured closure observation, not CONNECT or last packet.

Original SessionId, opening attachment and generation; capture admissible logical close time once, select CONNECT/DISCONNECT policy and reserve a control continuation before submitting canonical Detach.
Keep the same OperationId and canonical observed_at. Resolve with reserved capacity; no timer or new detachment occurrence may turn unknown into certainty.
Known durable offline occurrence contains its original operation and exact deadline. Retain at most one keyed timer for the session; a timer is a request, not direct cache deletion.
OpenAt and Expire share the writer order. If now is strictly before the current deadline, retain the same session/business state, replace its attachment and invalidate the old detachment.
At or after the applicable deadline, OpenAt atomically cleans up the expired incarnation before establishing a new one with Session Present0, even if the timer has not run.
Exact SessionId, opening guard and current detached operation/deadline; still offline, finite, and admissible now at or after deadline. Reserve control receipt and reuse atomic target-only cleanup.
Resume, another detachment, takeover, Clean Start or a new same-name incarnation changed the current guard. Ignore the old timer without retargeting it.
Known atomic expiry removes this target only, including its routes, claims and inbound state. Shared payload and obligations owed to other destinations remain; credits return once.
No continuity proved: preserve committed logical progress, ignore unknown downtime, and commit the new domain/tick anchor before durable decisions. Existing logical deadlines do not reset.

Same recognized domain and nondecreasing tick: account elapsed BOOTTIME through repeated process crashes. Attached-at-crash finite sessions get one reliable startup detach; durable detachments retain their deadline.

Only while finite offline sessions exist: one coalesced CAS checkpoint in flight, overwrite the single anchor, no operation receipt/history. Period30s; observation after31s reports actual delayed commitment instead of promising a false bound.
